pr_title: EQL: Fix bug in sequences with any pattern
pr_body:
Fix query creation inside sequences with any queries due to lacking a
clause to combine, which lead to an invalid request being created.

Fix #62967

issue_context.title: EQL : Sequences Not Working Using the Any Operator
issue_context.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`7.9.2`): reproduces on kibana.siem.estc.dev

**Plugins installed**: []

**JVM version** (`java -version`):

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system):

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:

Sequences are not working when the `any` operator is used.

**Steps to reproduce**:

These example queries return errors:

```
GET .siem-signals-siem-estc-dev-default-000001/_eql/search
{
  "query": """
   sequence by host.name
  [ any where true]
  [ any where true]
  """
}
GET .siem-signals-siem-estc-dev-default-000001/_eql/search
{
  "query": """
   sequence by host.name
  [ any where signal.rule.name == "f"]
  [ any where signal.rule.name == "hosts"]
  """
}

GET .siem-signals-siem-estc-dev-default-000001/_eql/search
{
  "query": """
   sequence
  [ any where signal.rule.name == "hosts"] by host.name
  [ any where signal.rule.name == "f"] by host.name
  """
}

```
comments:
Not sure this is specific to the `any` operator? This query also errors:

```
GET .siem-signals-siem-estc-dev-default-000001/_eql/search
{
  "query": """
   sequence by host.name
  [ process where true]
  [ network where true]
  """
}
